reuse.why: The new helper wraps getScheduledAmount, but it recomputes the 7.5% tolerance inline instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold in shared/rules.ts that matching already uses.

duplication.why: The tolerance formula Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075) is copied from getApproxNumberThreshold, and the preview and posting sites keep their own null/number dispatch around the new helper.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount, where the tree keeps the expected-amount rule, though the tolerance belongs to shared/rules.ts.

scope.why: Mostly focused; the ynab5 importer edit only satisfies the required expectedAmount type, and some call sites are reformatted with odd indentation.

maintainability.why: Preview still short-circuits numbers before the helper, so approximate schedules preview at the exact value while posting uses the worst case; schedule-template still uses its own midpoint; and the tolerance now lives in two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getExpectedScheduleAmount reimplements getApproxNumberThreshold; computeSchedulePreviewTransactions keeps `typeof _amount === 'number' ? _amount` before the helper, so approximate amounts bypass it; budget/schedule-template.ts keeps its own amount calculation.

disguised_duplication.where: getExpectedScheduleAmount inlines getApproxNumberThreshold's formula as a local `tolerance` with an explanatory comment instead of calling it.

one_place.where: The rule is in getExpectedScheduleAmount, but the preview path in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions returns numeric amounts before reaching it, schedule-template.ts computes its own amount, and UI callers still use getScheduledAmount without the op.
